photos.caption: Black Friday plan: hang the lights. Actual Black Friday: forty minutes negotiating with one knot. The knot is winning.
Yelling at a TV like I'm the coach. Pie is my emotional support.
Day-before-Thanksgiving errand: one balloon, zero chill. The wind tried to take it and I nearly let it win.
Leaf season finally reached Houston. I got the window leaves going and then went outside to supervise the real ones.
Found a real chemical photo booth. Eight minutes of waiting for four frames of me being smug. Worth it.
Market haul: a squash the size of my ego and a baguette I'm totally saving for later. (I'm not.)
Friday night, hanging off a wall by my fingertips. Didn't finish the purple route. Looked incredible failing it.
Homemade dumplings. Perfectly pleated? No. Better than your takeout? Obviously.
First skate of the season and not a single wobble. Hot cider in one hand, confidence in the other.
One strike, zero humility. Lane 6 can stop clapping now, I already know.
Went in for one cute beret. Left with the beret AND custody of this reindeer sweater. Monday: handled.
